scopeDecisions.authorization: The supervising host authenticates and owns the instance grant and durable inventory. A participant cannot supply the equipment assignment as a player input.
scopeDecisions.fallback: Missing, unknown and cross-family morph IDs select the configured family base. An unknown model is rejected. An omitted weapon in a change selects the scenario basic attack.
scopeDecisions.commitBoundary: Existing released non-beam basic deliveries must reach terminal before a different equipment assignment. A held beam ends with its old profile and cooldown. A detached field keeps its armor policy.
scopeDecisions.recovery: The financial-only process checkpoint records accepted operations and can return identical receipts. A same-World reconnect republishes the live combat and equipment.
scopeDecisions.statusDefinitions: Combat rules allow up to 32 definitions. Active instance and per-binding budgets retain their previous caps.
scopeDecisions.scratch: One reused batch scratch directory. Cargo used the shared build cache.
